400.description: Bad request - Missing required fields (query or profileId)

403.description: Forbidden - Profile not accessible or not published (when profileId provided)

200.description: SSE connection established - sends real-time context updates
File uploaded successfully - processing starts in background

400.description: Bad request - File required, invalid file type, or file size exceeds limit

file.description: The file to upload (TXT, DOCX, Markdown, JSON, or PDF, max 10MB)

profileId.description: AI profile ID to associate the context with

apiKey.description: AI service API key for authentication

userId.description: User ID who owns the context

errorMessage.description: Error message if status is error

vectorIds.description: Array of vector IDs stored in vector database

post.description: Grant access to a memory profile for one or more users. Supports batch invites. Returns 207 on partial success.

get.description: List all users who have access to a profile. Only the profile owner can view this.

patch.description: Update the role of an existing access entry. Only the profile owner can change roles.

delete.description: Revoke access, removing the user from the profile. Only the profile owner can revoke.

get.description: Get paginated activity log for a profile. Requires viewer+ access.
List notifications for the authenticated user. Supports pagination and unread-only filter.
